$description: Sampo's design system (SAMPO.md, Design: ancient forge meets living machine). The one source the site, the pane and statusline, the fm code TUI theme, Desktop, README diagrams and share images read. brand holds the six materials; light and dark map them to roles, and components use roles only. Forge light and ember are fire, never a status: status hues sit 30 degrees or more from both. Proved by plugin/tests/test_sampo_design.py.

forge-light.$description: the glow inside carved runes and the mill's eye; on iron only

hammered-bronze.$description: rims, gear teeth, rules; graphics, not body text

blueprint.$description: the drawing field; its lines are blueprint-line

ember.$description: sparks and the one live point (a cursor, a lit rune); never a fill larger than a rune

light.$description: Parchment and iron: a forge drawing on the bench.

stone.$description: the iron the mark is cut in; glow and ember sit on it

accent.$description: links, the one primary action, the selection: blueprint ink

bronze.$description: kickers, rules and headings in bronze

glow.$description: forge light, on iron surfaces only

ember.$description: sparks; graphics, never text on parchment

dark.$description: Iron and forge light: the smithy at night.

stone.$description: the iron the mark is cut in, a step above the night

accent.$description: blueprint line: links, the one primary action, the selection

bronze.$description: kickers, rules and headings in bronze

display.$description: inscriptional old-style serif for headlines, 600, tracked +0.02em: carved, not fantasy

mono.$description: terminal-crisp: commands, numbers, labels on drawings; tabular figures

motion.$description: The UI tokens are motion.md's; the mark's motion is the mill: it turns, its runes light in order, sparks leave the eye, then it rests. Every autoplay ends within autoplay-limit and rests on the still; a loop runs only while work runs (the pane glyph) or under the pointer.

rune.$description: one rune lighting; runes follow each other by this step

turn.$description: the mark's stone or gear turning once on load

mill.$description: a heavy stone: starts slow, coasts to rest

autoplay-limit.$description: WCAG 2.2.2: motion that starts on its own ends by here

reduced.$description: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-motion="reduce") drops every animation to none and shows the still: the rest frame, every rune lit, no sparks. Colour and opacity changes of 150ms or less stay.
